purpose: Start the real MeshCore HTTP server under recorder-managed lifecycle control.
Show registration, lease rotation, discovery state changes, and the compared validation boundaries with actual responses.
output:
MeshCore registration, lease, discovery, and validation demonstration

=== first registration ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-b", "leaseToken": "7e7a97a58abfbaacb0f757c8128884f9", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, "status": 201}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 201 with a non-empty leaseToken and RFC3339 expiresAt

=== second instance ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-a
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-a", "leaseToken": "07b577303d16b529ef8f7232e842f99f", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, "status": 201}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 201

=== sorted discovery ===
REQUEST GET /v1/discovery/demo-svc
ACTUAL {"body": {"instances": [{"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-a", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-b", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}], "service": "demo-svc"}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200; node-a then node-b; no leaseToken in instances

=== overwrite rotates lease ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.9:9000", "metadata": {"build": "new"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v3", "weight": 75, "zone": "z2"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.9:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-b", "leaseToken": "e8f09c49820084fc12ad660cae255a5f", "metadata": {"build": "new"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v3", "weight": 75, "zone": "z2"}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200 with a new leaseToken

=== old token cannot renew ===
REQUEST POST /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b/heartbeat
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "lease_conflict"}}, "status": 409}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 409 lease_conflict

=== current token renews ===
REQUEST POST /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b/heartbeat
ACTUAL {"body": "", "status": 204}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 204

=== current token unregisters ===
REQUEST DELETE /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
ACTUAL {"body": "", "status": 204}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 204

=== deleted instance stays absent ===
REQUEST GET /v1/discovery/demo-svc
ACTUAL {"body": {"instances": [{"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-02T18:57:02Z", "instance": "node-a", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "service": "demo-svc", "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}], "service": "demo-svc"}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200 containing only node-a

### Boundary reproduction shared by both sealed candidates

=== empty metadata value ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-boundary/instances/meta
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:9001", "metadata": {"key": ""}, "ttlSeconds": 20, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "validation_error"}}, "status": 400}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 400 validation_error

=== duplicate zone filter ===
REQUEST GET /v1/discovery/demo-boundary?zone=z1&zone=z2
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "validation_error"}}, "status": 400}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 400 validation_error

=== invalid path with wrong method ===
REQUEST GET /v1/services/bad!/instances/node
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "method_not_allowed"}}, "status": 405}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 400 validation_error

Demo complete; ACTUAL lines above are the product responses and remain visible even when they differ from the public expectation.
